#b#e14th Street Coin#n#k
This is your chance to earn 14th Street points by participating in all the fun activities. For every 100 points you earn, you'll get a 14th Street Coin that you can trade for cool stuff in the Big Bang Store, Restaurant RED, or Override Fashion.

#b#e14th Street Celeb Status#n#k
Every time you take advantage of the great 14th Street stores or resolve others' worries, your celeb status will rise, and you'll get improved stats on the #b14th Street Fairgoer#k title! Select Celeb Status in the 14th Street Notifier for more details.
